inputs.name: go_version
inputs.description: Go release to install, such as "1.27.3". Change checksums with it.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the linux-amd64 and linux-arm64 .tar.gz tarballs, from https://go.dev/dl/. Change these with go_version.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: Commands to build with go install into /usr/local/bin, by package path, each at an exact version, such as { "github.com/oapi-codegen/oapi-codegen/v2/cmd/oapi-codegen" = "v2.8.1" }.
